id: T1055
title: "Process Injection"
tactic: defense-evasion
platforms: [Windows, Linux]
source: "MITRE ATT&CK T1055"
license: "CC BY 4.0"
---

Adversaries may inject code into processes in order to evade process-based
defenses and possibly elevate privileges.

## Detection

Cross-process memory writes, remote thread creation, and unusual
`ptrace`/`OpenProcess` combinations.
